title: Process
subject: Operating Systems
subtitle: A Program in Execution
guiding_question: What happens when a computer actually runs a program?
description: A process is a program in execution, together with its current state and the resources the operating system manages for it.

learning_objectives.text: Explain the difference between a program and a process.
Identify the main components and states of a process.
Explain how an operating system manages process execution.
